item.title: Supply gaps stall commodity markets
item.description: THE prices of major agricultural commodities have remained flat on the Zimbabwe Mercantile Exchange (ZMX) as weak supplies and limited farmer participation constrained trading. Maize held at US$364 per tonne, soya beans at US$551 and wheat at US$490 during the week to October 16, #Zimbabwe #Business #ZimbabweEconomy #ZimbabweNews
